candidates.description: These tokens represent text fragments involving Hindi Devanagari script characters and Latin transliterations of South Asian linguistic syllables or abbreviations.
This feature vector represents sub-word tokens and character fragments commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari text.
This vector activates for common Hindi character n-grams and word suffixes.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and sub-word units, primarily focusing on Hindi text tokens.
This feature vector represents the processing of common Devanagari suffixes, root endings, and character n-grams frequently found in Hindi vocabulary.
This vector activates for common Hindi root words, prefixes, and syllable fragments.
This vector activates on common subwords, syllables, and vocabulary words in the Marathi language.
This vector represents common suffixes and root endings in Hindi words.
This vector activates for characters and subword tokens belonging to the Devanagari script used in Indian languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and fragments of Hindi script.
